{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Elegant sheath dress in deep emerald green (#0a4f38), A-line silhouette falling to mid-calf length, velvet fabric with a subtle matte finish.
Classic pointed-toe pumps in polished black leather (#121212), moderate heel height for comfort during an extended evening.
Delicate gold-toned drop earrings and a matching clutch bag in structured satin (#d4af37) to catch the restaurant's artificial lighting without overpowering the look.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between celebratory elegance and refined sophistication required for a formal birthday banquet. The deep emerald velvet of the dress offers a luxurious texture that catches the warm artificial light beautifully, creating a focal point worthy of a milestone occasion. Paired with classic black heels and subtle gold accents, the ensemble elevates her natural complexion while adhering strictly to the formal dress code without appearing overly stiff."}
